records.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`, which overcounts when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 100/50 => 3 instead of 2). Since `showingLast` is `propertyEqual("currentPage", "totalPages")`, the UI will think there is an extra page. The `next` action then sets `offset = Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, allowing `offset == user_count`, and `Group.findMembers` uses that offset in the AJAX call, yielding an empty `members` page.

records.issue_text: Public members endpoint has no cap on limit/offset params, allowing DoS via limit=100000000 and unvalidated offset (negatives/huge values)

There is no maximum bound on `limit` and no normalization of `offset` (negative or extremely large values), so a request like `?limit=100000000&offset=-10` could cause excessive DB/load or errors depending on DB/ActiveRecord behavior.
